name: Kosame Hot Pot
description: Kosame Hot Pot is a quiet block theme for hot pot, shabu-shabu and sukiyaki restaurants that take table and private-room bookings. A sticky half-screen low-key photo stage sits beside one narrow paper column of vertical section headers, with a four-line booking frame, link boxes, price and info tables, a parallax photograph band and a newsletter slot.
